snippet.title: 8:00 AM : Still Morning｜Game Trailer
snippet.description:
8:00 AM – Still Morning is a short narrative exploration game about moving through a familiar morning routine.

Make breakfast. Walk through familiar rooms. Interact with everyday objects.

Somewhere between these small actions, something feels slightly out of place — and you begin to understand why.

🌐 Language : English & Japenese & Korean & Chinese
🎮 Platform : PC ( Itcn.io , Steam )

💠Itch.io Page  : https://square588168.itch.io/8am-still-morning

💠Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4368810/800_AM__Still_Morning/?beta=0

💠Music : いつかの景色 - DOVA-SYNDROME


This is a game about mornings that keep happening — even when not everyone is ready to wake up.


#indiegame #rpgmaker #narrativegame #shortgame #atmosphericgame #walkingsimulator #rpgmakermv
